segments.summary: Reviewed all seven Settings and Agent Config units exactly and adversarially; extracted the ownership contract and missing behavioral oracles.
Reviewed personas, provider evidence, failover, Docker routing, account binding, panel persistence, and Terminal ownership, including privacy and mutation failure cases.
Reviewed shortcut, Skills, project status, attention, concern, notification, and record-shape units, including lifecycle and cross-surface consistency attacks.
Reviewed alert evidence, attention authority, alert lifecycle, and threaded-chat behavior with concurrency, rollback, stale mirror, and scale lenses.
Reviewed composer, queue, command, File Manager, File Editor, and architecture constraints with destructive, remote, untrusted-input, and accessibility attacks.
Reviewed native boundaries, browser identities, GUI seams, annotations, activity, and audit inspection, including authorization, privacy, redaction, and corrupt-reference cases.
Reviewed document and bundle review, runtime-zone identity, debug panes, widget scope, and SelectableText with transition, crash, migration, and restore attacks.
Reviewed widgets, reactive projections, state categories, command mutation, conflicts, and persistence with ordering, merge, backpressure, corruption, and mixed-version attacks.
